And more is coming: by 26 November, the forecast brings 47 cm at Astun, 47 cm at Cauterets Cirque du Lys and 45 cm at Formigal. A word on the numbers: resort values are our model's estimate for the upper slopes, while each station measures a single spot on the date given. In the field we always carry a probe; numbers like these tell you where to go, the probe tells you what is under your skis.

p: Among the resorts in this report, Cauterets Cirque du Lys has the deepest snow up high today, about 20 cm, ahead of Astun 16 cm and La Pierre Saint-Martin 13 cm.
Today 43 of the 53 resorts in the Pyrenees have snow on their upper slopes; in all, our model counts 2,480 km² under snow.
Up to 47 cm of new snow is forecast at Astun over the next days.
Forecasts move: the timing is usually more reliable than the totals, so check again two days before you go.

That is more than in 11 of the 46 past winters on this date.
In past winters the best snow at Astun usually came early February / late February.

The snow is not done yet: we expect 44 cm at Artouste and 42 cm at La Pierre Saint-Martin by 26 November.
